tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search KW's current public catalogue by keyword, brand or exact model/SKU, with existing category, ex-GST price, website In Stock, sort and supported width filters. Returns at most 8 results, no pagination. Main prices include GST; ex-GST prices are also provided.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one exact product_id or canonical slug from search_products. Returns existing public specifications, warranty, current AUD prices including and excluding GST, website supply status and KW product link. Missing/discontinued/hidden identities return product_not_found.
